WITH state_counts AS (
  SELECT c.state_county_province, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customer_count
  FROM Customers c
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Accounts a
    WHERE a.customer_id = c.customer_id
  )
  GROUP BY c.state_county_province
), state_shares AS (
  SELECT customer_count * 1.0 / SUM(customer_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM state_counts
), classified AS (
  SELECT share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM state_shares
)
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN share > average_share THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS combined_count,
       AVG(CASE WHEN share > average_share THEN share END) AS average_share,
       AVG(CASE WHEN share > average_share THEN share - average_share END) AS average_excess_share
FROM classified;
